subject: Re: Kickoff - seq2seq coref as the multilingual backbone
body:
Priya,

Staffing for the window:

- Yusuf Keita 60%, transition system, evaluation against CoNLL-2012 and our internal sets.
- Katya Silva 45%, fine-tuning runs and the non-English data prep.
- Chiara Olsen is at 65% on coref_mt5 for the whole of June 2026 - she owns the decoder service and the transition-state serialization, and June is when both have to be production-shaped. She's at 30% in April/May ramping in.

Infra: the XXL checkpoint needs a real server, not a notebook. Zeke has us penciled in on Shipyard for a June serving slot. Inference is the cost driver here, not training - we are fine-tuning, not pre-training, so 32 GPUs on vulcan-h100 covers us.

One caveat I want on record: 65% of Chiara in June is the plan of record. If that slips the serving benchmark slips with it.

Daniela
